items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: And, in the rhythm section we had Teddy Wilson, and later Charlie Beal. We had Yank Larson on drums, and later Harry Dewe.

ctx.x: But, anyway, getting back to ZT. ZT would write this hard music, then. But, this one, this is one time he did stick us. We really just couldn't play. We had -- oh, yeah. We had Scoville Brown in the band, too.
Saxophone player. Saxophone and clarinet. And, he --
